R/ [SALVS DD NN AVG ET CAES]

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Magnentius or Decentius (350-353), Chi Rho issue of 352-353, Reece period 18. Inscription trimmed away. Obverse description: Bust right. Reverse description: Chi Rho. Reverse inscription: [SALVS DD NN AVG ET CAES]. Diameter: 20.2mm, Weight: 1.96gms, die axis: possibly 6
